title: Collapse Resilience Framework Port
summary: Ported entangle.zig, merge.zig, sybil.zig from SFTP Qstar into hardware qstar-llm. Created collapse_resilience.zig orchestrator that ties together collapse, entangle, qr_nest, and seed_compressor into a full persist/recover pipeline.

contents: GF(256) Galois Field arithmetic (exp/log tables, mul/div/pow/inv)
Shamir secret sharing (shamirSplit, shamirRecover, Share, ShareList)
CellEdit struct for concurrent lattice cell edits
MergeResult with winning peer and strategy
Mobius twist: boundary cells use reversed comparison
Proof-of-Lattice-Work (PoLW) using E0 node hash + octonion routing
Persist pipeline: compress → RS encode → Shamir split → atomize → nest → distribute
Recover pipeline: reassemble → Shamir recover → RS reconstruct → decompress
CollapseStatus with portal/shard/share counts and data_integrity
Default config: RS(4,2) + Shamir(3,5) = 33% data loss tolerance

build_integration.build_zig_changes: Made sybil/merge/entangle always-available (not just full_deps). Added collapse_resilience_mod after seed_compressor_mod.
build_integration.bug_fix: Fixed QRPortal atomizeCell to always call setPayload even for empty faces (was causing data_integrity=0 for small data)

floating_point_note: DLCZ and Kleinberg modules use f64 for simulation/transport (sidecar). GF(256), Reed-Solomon, Shamir, PoLW are all integer-only (u8/u32/u64). CellEdit.activation uses f64 but is a transport/sidecar field.
